description: Troubleshooting procedure for faults occurring during robotic ejection and placement of a part onto a nest in preparation for insert installation.

box_1.text: Does the product meet quality assurance team product specifications?

box_2.text: Verify that the product meets quality assurance team specifications before proceeding.

box_3.text: Remove the current batch, load a new batch of parts, and reverify product quality against quality assurance specifications.

box_4.text: Is the part placement in the indexing table correct?

box_5.text: Follow the indexing table placement diagnostic (GRAPH 18).

box_7.text: Is the setup of the indexing table correct?

box_8.text: Follow the indexing table setup procedure.

box_11.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the actuator guide for contamination. 2. Check the mounting heads for contamination.

box_12.text: Pneumatic flow measurement procedure: vacuum flow check

box_13.text: Clean the parts and lubricate the actuator guide.

box_15.text: Complete the following checks in order: 1. Check the vacuum generator for correct operation. 2. Check the input/output signal configuration on the operator control interface. 3. Check the electrical valve actuator control. 4. Check the proximity sensors.

box_18.text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the actuator guide for wear. 2. Check the mounting heads for wear.

box_19.text: Replace the worn actuator components identified in the inspection (guide and/or mounting heads).

box_21.text: Refer to the mounting speed specification for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_22.text: Refer to the mounting speed specification for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_23.text: Refer to the mounting speed specification for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_24.text: Readjust the speed with the flow control valve

box_25.text: Is the height of the part lifter relative to the indexing table correct?

box_26.text: Refer to the part lifter height check relative to indexing table for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_27.text: Refer to the part lifter height check relative to indexing table for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_28.text: Refer to the part lifter height check relative to indexing table for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_29.text: Adjust the height of the part lifter relative to the indexing table to match the specified value.

box_30.text: Is the X/Y position relative to the indexing table correct?

box_31.text: Refer to the x/y position check relative to indexing table with setup tool for variant A machines (small format parts).

box_32.text: Refer to the x/y position check relative to indexing table with setup tool for variant B machines (medium format parts).

box_33.text: Refer to the x/y position check relative to indexing table with setup tool for variant C machines (large format parts).

box_34.text: Adjust the X/Y position of the mounting unit relative to the indexing table to the correct position using the setup tool.

box_35.text: Verify that the part is mounted centred and straight from the indexing table, all actuators have reached their end positions, and all part lifters are at equal height.

box_36.text: Part mounting for insert placement is correct
